items.quote: At that time Sibbekai the Hushathite killed Saph, one of the descendants of Rapha. In another battle
items.contrast: Sibbekai, the killer in the first battle described at Gob, versus Elhanan, the killer in the subsequent battle.
items.reason: The passage names Sibbekai as the killer and then introduces Elhanan’s action as occurring “in another battle,” so Sibbekai kills first in the narrated sequence.
